title: Trump on Rogan links JFK records to people coming from space

tellings.quote: And then Trump leads the transition of the conversation from like Rogan talking about JFK records and how many people are are interested in them and then Rogan go and then Trump goes many people are also interested in the people coming from space.
Donald Trump on Joe Rogan Experience. Uh he immediately pointed to Mars.
tellings.difference: Says Trump pointed to Mars; the story's telling has him bring up people coming from space after talk of the JFK records.
tellings.link_reason: Both are Trump's 2024 appearance on the Joe Rogan Experience, at the moment he turns to the subject of beings from space.

as_told.title: Trump points to Mars on the Joe Rogan Experience

plain: In 2024, on the comedian Joe Rogan's podcast, Donald Trump is said to have steered talk about the JFK files toward life from space. A guest named Matthew Pines tells Michels that when Rogan spoke of how many people want to see the Kennedy records, Trump replied that many people are also interested in "the people coming from space". Michels remembers the same interview another way: he says Trump "immediately pointed to Mars". Both treat the moment as a sign that Trump knows something about the subject.
